cards.gloss_en: stubborn and hard to control or manage
cards.ex_en: The refractory horse refused to obey its rider.
cards.ex_cn: 那匹倔强的马不肯听骑手的话。

cards.gloss_en: people who commit crimes or evil deeds
cards.ex_en: The judge sentenced the malefactors to prison.
cards.ex_cn: 法官判这些罪犯入狱。

cards.gloss_en: extremely wicked or evil
cards.ex_en: The story has a villainous pirate as its enemy.
cards.ex_cn: 故事里有个邪恶的海盗作反派。

cards.gloss_en: caught in a trap or trick
cards.ex_en: The rabbit was ensnared by a hidden net.
cards.ex_cn: 兔子被一张藏起来的网困住了。

cards.gloss_en: an official order giving someone authority
cards.ex_en: The officer showed his commission to the guards.
cards.ex_cn: 军官向卫兵出示了他的委任状。

cards.gloss_en: begged someone earnestly for something
cards.ex_en: She implored her father to let her go.
cards.ex_cn: 她恳求父亲让她去。

cards.gloss_en: make an animal or person fatter
cards.ex_en: The farmer fed the pigs to fatten them.
cards.ex_cn: 农夫喂猪好让它们长肥。

cards.gloss_en: a change to behave better than before
cards.ex_en: He promised amendment after his big mistake.
cards.ex_cn: 他犯了大错后保证改过。

cards.gloss_en: preserved in vinegar or salt water
cards.ex_en: We ate pickled vegetables with our rice.
cards.ex_cn: 我们就着米饭吃腌菜。

cards.gloss_en: the act of pleading on behalf of another
cards.ex_en: Through his intercession, the boy was forgiven.
cards.ex_cn: 由于他的求情,男孩得到了原谅。

cards.gloss_en: old objects kept as reminders of the past
cards.ex_en: She kept these old coins as relics of the war.
cards.ex_cn: 她把这些旧硬币留作战争的纪念物。

cards.gloss_en: no longer existing or all dead
cards.ex_en: That whole family line is now extinct.
cards.ex_cn: 那整支家族如今已经绝后。

cards.gloss_en: knowledge or awareness of something
cards.ex_en: The matter came within the judge's cognisance.
cards.ex_cn: 这件事在法官的知悉范围之内。

cards.gloss_en: a person who manages affairs for another
cards.ex_en: His procurator handled the estate while he was away.
cards.ex_cn: 他外出时由代理人打理产业。

cards.gloss_en: an official in charge of public revenue
cards.ex_en: The fiscal collected the taxes for the crown.
cards.ex_cn: 司库为王室征收赋税。

cards.gloss_en: took something for one's own use
cards.ex_en: The manager appropriated the funds for himself.
cards.ex_cn: 经理把款项挪为己用。

cards.gloss_en: spent money, time, or effort
cards.ex_en: They expended all their savings on the house.
cards.ex_cn: 他们把所有积蓄都花在房子上。

cards.gloss_en: the act of changing one thing into another
cards.ex_en: The conversion of dollars into pounds took a minute.
cards.ex_cn: 把美元折算成英镑花了一分钟。

cards.gloss_en: money that a business or state receives
cards.ex_en: The farm's revenue rose every year.
cards.ex_cn: 农场的收入逐年增加。

cards.gloss_en: a person who supplies food and provisions
cards.ex_en: The providore stocked the ship with food.
cards.ex_cn: 军需官为船只备足了食物。

cards.gloss_en: necessary as a duty for someone
cards.ex_en: It is incumbent on us to help the sick.
cards.ex_cn: 帮助病人是我们义不容辞的责任。

cards.gloss_en: something that blocks a way or progress
cards.ex_en: A fallen tree was an obstruction on the road.
cards.ex_cn: 一棵倒下的树成了路上的障碍。

cards.gloss_en: officially recorded on a list
cards.ex_en: The deed was enrolled at the court.
cards.ex_cn: 这份契据在法院登记入册。

cards.gloss_en: a person who carries out a will
cards.ex_en: His brother was named executor of the will.
cards.ex_cn: 他的兄弟被指定为遗嘱执行人。

cards.gloss_en: interfere in matters that are not one's own
cards.ex_en: He would not intermeddle in their quarrel.
cards.ex_cn: 他不愿插手他们的争吵。

cards.gloss_en: thick dark syrup made from sugar
cards.ex_en: She poured molasses over the warm bread.
cards.ex_cn: 她在热面包上浇了糖蜜。

cards.gloss_en: take or set aside for one's own use
cards.ex_en: The court will appropriate the land to him.
cards.ex_cn: 法庭会把这块地拨归他。

cards.gloss_en: a written statement sworn to be true
cards.ex_en: He signed an affidavit before the lawyer.
cards.ex_cn: 他在律师面前签了一份宣誓书。

cards.gloss_en: stating firmly that something is true
cards.ex_en: She kept affirming that she was innocent.
cards.ex_cn: 她一再坚称自己是无辜的。

cards.gloss_en: attached or fastened to something
cards.ex_en: A seal was affixed to the letter.
cards.ex_cn: 信上盖了一枚印章。

cards.gloss_en: a small parcel of papers or things
cards.ex_en: A thick packet of letters arrived today.
cards.ex_cn: 今天到了一大包信件。

cards.gloss_cn: 克鲁扎多(葡萄牙旧金币)
cards.gloss_en: old Portuguese gold or silver coins
cards.ex_en: He paid the debt in crusadoes.
cards.ex_cn: 他用克鲁扎多金币还了债。

cards.gloss_en: not yet made into coins
cards.ex_en: The chest held uncoined gold from the mine.
cards.ex_cn: 箱子里装着矿上未铸币的黄金。

cards.gloss_en: a doctor who treats illness with medicine
cards.ex_en: The physician gave her some medicine to drink.
cards.ex_cn: 内科医生给了她一些药喝。

cards.gloss_en: pay back or reward someone for something
cards.ex_en: He wished to recompense his old friend.
cards.ex_cn: 他想报答他的老朋友。

cards.gloss_en: carry out a duty or pay off a debt
cards.ex_en: He worked hard to discharge his debts.
cards.ex_cn: 他努力工作以偿清债务。

cards.gloss_en: giving someone official power to act
cards.ex_en: A letter empowering him to sell the house arrived.
cards.ex_cn: 一封授权他卖房的信到了。

cards.gloss_en: a person appointed to collect money
cards.ex_en: The receiver gathered the yearly rents.
cards.ex_cn: 代收人收取每年的租金。

cards.gloss_en: a separate part of a legal document
cards.ex_en: The contract had a clause about repairs.
cards.ex_cn: 合同里有一条关于维修的条款。

cards.gloss_en: returned a favour or feeling to someone
cards.ex_en: She requited his kindness with a gift.
cards.ex_cn: 她以礼物回报他的好意。

cards.gloss_en: openly declared a belief or feeling
cards.ex_en: He professed his loyalty to the king.
cards.ex_cn: 他公开表明对国王的忠诚。

cards.gloss_en: not yet dealt with or settled
cards.ex_en: Some of the goods were still undisposed of.
cards.ex_cn: 有些货物还没处理掉。

cards.gloss_en: a priest, especially a Catholic one
cards.ex_en: The padre blessed the sailors before the voyage.
cards.ex_cn: 神父在启航前为水手祝福。

cards.gloss_en: fine smooth woollen cloth
cards.ex_en: His coat was made of black broadcloth.
cards.ex_cn: 他的外套是用黑色细呢做的。

cards.gloss_en: made to have an opinion beforehand
cards.ex_en: He was prepossessed against travelling by sea.
cards.ex_cn: 他对坐船旅行早有成见。

cards.gloss_en: too unpleasant to bear
cards.ex_en: The heat at noon was insufferable.
cards.ex_cn: 正午的酷热让人难以忍受。

cards.gloss_en: making the body numb, especially with cold
cards.ex_en: A benumbing wind blew across the pass.
cards.ex_cn: 一阵使人麻木的寒风吹过山口。

cards.gloss_en: the chance that something will happen
cards.ex_en: There is little likelihood of rain today.
cards.ex_cn: 今天下雨的可能性很小。

cards.gloss_en: caused trouble or discomfort to someone
cards.ex_en: The heavy snow incommoded the travellers.
cards.ex_cn: 大雪给旅客带来了不便。

cards.gloss_en: make safe or guarantee against harm
cards.ex_en: The guide could not insure them from wolves.
cards.ex_cn: 向导无法保证他们不受狼的侵害。

cards.gloss_en: very steep and dangerous cliffs
cards.ex_en: The path ran along high precipices.
cards.ex_cn: 小路沿着高高的悬崖伸展。

cards.gloss_en: follows a winding, twisting path
cards.ex_en: The river meanders through the green valley.
cards.ex_cn: 河流蜿蜒穿过绿色的山谷。

cards.gloss_en: weighed down or hindered by a burden
cards.ex_en: He was encumbered with heavy bags.
cards.ex_cn: 他被沉重的行李拖累着。

cards.gloss_en: in a strong, energetic way
cards.ex_en: The children sang lustily at the party.
cards.ex_cn: 孩子们在派对上起劲地唱歌。

cards.gloss_en: greatly increased or made twice as strong
cards.ex_en: The echo redoubled the sound of the guns.
cards.ex_cn: 回声使枪声成倍地放大。

cards.gloss_en: freed someone or something from a hold
cards.ex_en: He disengaged the dog from the ropes.
cards.ex_cn: 他把狗从绳子里解救出来。

cards.gloss_en: in a bold and brave manner
cards.ex_en: The soldiers fought hardily against the enemy.
cards.ex_cn: 士兵们勇猛地与敌人作战。

cards.gloss_en: in a firm and unwavering way
cards.ex_en: She looked steadfastly at the door.
cards.ex_cn: 她坚定地盯着门。

cards.gloss_en: an open insult to someone's pride
cards.ex_en: His rude words were an affront to us all.
cards.ex_cn: 他无礼的话是对我们所有人的侮辱。

cards.gloss_en: insulted someone openly and rudely
cards.ex_en: She felt affronted by his cold reply.
cards.ex_cn: 他冷淡的回答让她感到被冒犯。

cards.gloss_en: walking slowly by dragging the feet
cards.ex_en: The old man came shuffling down the hall.
cards.ex_cn: 老人拖着脚步走过大厅。

cards.gloss_en: quickly and lightly with easy movement
cards.ex_en: The cat leapt nimbly onto the wall.
cards.ex_cn: 猫敏捷地跳上了墙。

cards.gloss_en: walk or stand unsteadily as if falling
cards.ex_en: The baby began to totter across the room.
cards.ex_cn: 婴儿开始摇摇晃晃地走过房间。

cards.gloss_en: unsteady and easily upset or disturbed
cards.ex_en: The plank felt ticklish under his feet.
cards.ex_cn: 木板在他脚下摇摇晃晃。

cards.gloss_en: something said or done to cause laughter
cards.ex_en: He said it only in jest.
cards.ex_cn: 他说那话只是开玩笑。

cards.gloss_en: hold on tightly to something
cards.ex_en: The kitten will cling to the warm blanket.
cards.ex_cn: 小猫会紧紧贴着温暖的毯子。

cards.gloss_en: a narrow pass between mountains
cards.ex_en: The army marched through a rocky defile.
cards.ex_cn: 军队穿过一条多岩石的隘路。

cards.gloss_en: old units of distance, one-eighth of a mile
cards.ex_en: The village lay two furlongs away.
cards.ex_cn: 村子在两弗隆开外。

cards.gloss_en: lacking courage; easily frightened
cards.ex_en: The fainthearted guide trembled at the noise.
cards.ex_cn: 胆小的向导听到响声就发抖。

cards.gloss_en: rather dark, as at twilight
cards.ex_en: The room grew dusky as the sun set.
cards.ex_cn: 太阳落下时房间变得昏暗。

cards.gloss_en: the dead bodies of animals
cards.ex_en: The carcasses of two horses lay on the road.
cards.ex_cn: 两匹马的尸体躺在路上。

cards.gloss_en: get down from a horse or vehicle
cards.ex_en: The riders alighted at the inn door.
cards.ex_cn: 骑手们在客栈门口下了马。

cards.gloss_en: making a sharp click, as of a trigger
cards.ex_en: He kept snapping the empty pistol at the wolf.
cards.ex_cn: 他不停地空扣着手枪对着狼。

cards.gloss_en: not loaded with powder or shot
cards.ex_en: He aimed the uncharged gun to scare them.
cards.ex_cn: 他举起未装弹的枪来吓唬他们。

cards.gloss_en: an old word meaning sixty
cards.ex_en: Threescore sheep grazed on the hill.
cards.ex_cn: 六十只羊在山上吃草。

cards.gloss_en: becoming sore and inflamed
cards.ex_en: The wound was rankling and swollen.
cards.ex_cn: 伤口发炎肿了起来。

cards.gloss_en: passing freely, as accepted money does
cards.ex_en: The coins passed currently in every town.
cards.ex_cn: 这些硬币在每个镇子都通行无阻。

cards.gloss_en: sharing in private or secret knowledge
cards.ex_en: Only a few were privy to the plan.
cards.ex_cn: 只有少数人知悉这个计划。

cards.gloss_en: pure and free from any stain
cards.ex_en: She kept an unspotted reputation all her life.
cards.ex_cn: 她一生保持着清白的名声。

cards.gloss_en: persuaded someone not to do something
cards.ex_en: His friends dissuaded him from the voyage.
cards.ex_cn: 朋友们劝阻他不要出海。

cards.gloss_en: a person's death
cards.ex_en: After his decease, the land went to his son.
cards.ex_cn: 他去世后,土地归了他儿子。

cards.gloss_en: people who take over a position from others
cards.ex_en: He left the farm to his successors.
cards.ex_cn: 他把农场留给了继任者。

cards.gloss_en: each in the order already mentioned
cards.ex_en: Tom and Ann got a book and a pen respectively.
cards.ex_cn: 汤姆和安分别得到一本书和一支笔。
